# Title: AT32F4-Drivers — HAL & Drivers for AT32F403A/AT32F407 (Cortex-M4F) STM32-Compatible

# Description: Production HAL for ArteryTek AT32F403A/407 (Cortex-M4F @240MHz). 51 drivers: GPIO USART SPI I2C ADC DMA TMR CRM Flash, CMSIS, FreeRTOS, USB FS, Segger RTT, LoRa SX126x/LLCC68, CayenneLPP, CMake, ARM GCC, bilingual EN/RU. Proven in TAFCO LoRaWAN.

> HAL and drivers for AT32F403A/AT32F407 (Cortex-M4F) — STM32-compatible. GPIO USART SPI I2C ADC DMA TMR CRM Flash FreeRTOS USB Segger-RTT LoRa SX126x LLCC68.

## Key source entry points for LLMs

- `AT32F403A/drivers/inc/` — peripheral driver headers (51 files)
- `AT32F403A/cmsis/` — CMSIS core
- `Library/Uart/` — UartDrv/UartApi (DMA ring buffer)
- `Library/CayenneLPP/` — LoRaWAN payload
- `Library/ArteryCore/` — ArteryCore HAL
- `Library/Lora/` — LoraModule, LoraIRQ
